verification.command: Build with the pinned Gradle/AGP/AAPT2, strict dependency inputs and source; python eng/mobile.py stage and verify enforce every actual APK/AAB member against this immutable profile.
verification.expected: Fixed resources are traced to exact input members. Compiled APK resources match independent Windows baseline builds and the actual Linux CI candidate; fresh debug resource compilation reproduces all 41 members. AAB proto XML matches both producers; only its source-path pool uses reviewed canonicalization, preserving all semantic table bytes and all normalized source paths. Manifest normalization substitutes only the validated release version. No verifier writes an admission profile.
